field_updates.detail: Fig. 4 - Forward Current vs. Forward Voltage (red; log 1-100 mA vs 1-3 V; page header "TYPICAL CHARACTERISTICS (Tamb = 25 °C...)"). Read points: 1.00 mA @ 1.627 V (resid +7.3 mV); 2.00 mA @ 1.646 V (resid -5.6 mV); 5.00 mA @ 1.697 V (resid -7.6 mV); 10.00 mA @ 1.764 V (resid -0.7 mV); 20.00 mA @ 1.865 V (resid +6.0 mV); 30.00 mA @ 1.948 V (resid +5.1 mV); 50.00 mA @ 2.097 V (resid -4.5 mV). Cross-check: model VF(20 mA)=1.859 V vs stated typ 1.80 V (+59 mV); "Forward voltage IF = 20 mA VF - 1.8 2.2 V" (p2). Method: Curve read from the PDF vector path itself (pdftocairo -svg), axes calibrated from the drawn gridline coordinates; read points interpolated on the drawn centreline (log I). Least-squares fit of V = N*Vt*ln(I/IS) + I*RS (linear in N*Vt, N*Vt*ln IS, RS), Vt = kT/q at 25 C = 0.02569 V. Fit 7 points 1.00-50.0 mA, rms 5.7 mV. Window sensitivity: windows 1-20/1-30/1-50/2-30/5-30 mA give N 0.95-2.03, RS 6.4-9.1 ohm, IS 1.8e-32..6.8e-17 A. IS, N and RS are strongly correlated and must be used together as one set; individually they are not identified by this curve. If used in a .model with TNOM=27 C, re-reference IS or set TNOM=25.
field_updates.scope: Vishay TLDR4400 (red); IS for the OHMNI simulation model (fit to the datasheet's own data); not a guaranteed limit
